About SEAT.

A platform that makes finding the right study space easier.

SEAT. brings that information together, so students can spend less time searching and more time studying.

Why SEAT.

Finding the right place to study is harder than it should be.

Today, students jump between university websites, Google Maps, group chats and recommendations just to answer one simple question: where should I study today? Information about opening hours, facilities, atmosphere and nearby options is scattered across different places and is often difficult to compare.

SEAT. brings the answer into one place.

What SEAT. is

One platform for finding the right place to study.

SEAT. helps students compare study spaces based on the things that actually matter — location, opening hours, facilities, atmosphere and nearby amenities.

01

FIND

Discover study spaces that match your needs.

02

KNOW

See the information that matters before you go.

03

CONNECT

Discover places, communities and student recommendations.

Our Story

Built by students, for students.

We are students, and we face the same struggle ourselves. SEAT. was created to reduce the stress of finding a place to study, so students can spend less time searching and more time studying.

Jaqueline Kägi
Co-Founder
Nepheli Steuber

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 20 September 2026

1. Who we are

SEAT. is operated by its founders, Nepheli Steuber and Jaqueline Kägi.

For questions concerning privacy or personal data, please contact us at: seat.zh@outlook.com

2. Hosting

The SEAT. website is hosted directly by SEAT. in Switzerland.

When visitors access our website, certain technical information may be processed automatically, such as the IP address, browser type, device information, date and time of access, and server log data. This information is processed only where necessary to operate, secure, maintain, and improve the website.

We do not use an external hosting provider for the operation of the website.

3. Favourites and browser storage

SEAT. allows visitors to save study spaces as favourites.

Saved favourites are stored locally in the visitor’s browser. They are not transmitted to SEAT., do not contain personal identifiers and are not shared with third parties.

Visitors can remove this information by deleting their saved favourites or clearing the website data stored in their browser.

4. Cookies and analytics

SEAT. does not use cookies, analytics services, advertising trackers or tracking pixels.

We do not track visitors across other websites and do not create advertising or behavioural profiles.

The local browser storage used to save favourites is used only to provide functionality requested by the visitor.

5. Contacting us

If you contact SEAT. by email, we process the information you provide, such as your name, email address and message, to respond to your enquiry and manage any necessary follow-up communication.

Our email service is provided through Microsoft Outlook. Information included in an email may therefore be processed by Microsoft according to its applicable privacy terms.

Email information is retained only for as long as necessary to respond to the enquiry and complete any required follow-up, unless a longer retention period is required by law.

Please do not send sensitive personal information by email unless it is necessary.

6. External links

The SEAT. website contains standard links to external websites and services, including university and library websites, Google Maps and Instagram.

No information is transmitted to these services merely because a standard link is displayed. When a visitor chooses to open an external link, the privacy policy and terms of the destination website apply.

SEAT. is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

7. Sharing and international processing

SEAT. does not sell personal information.

Personal information may be processed by service providers that support the technical operation of the website or our email communication.

Where personal information is processed outside Switzerland, appropriate safeguards will be used where required by applicable data-protection law.

8. Data security

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse or alteration.

However, no internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

9. Your rights

Subject to applicable data-protection law, you may have the right to:

  • Request information about personal data processed about you
  • Request the correction of inaccurate information
  • Request the deletion of your personal information
  • Object to or request the restriction of certain processing
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent

To exercise these rights, contact: seat.zh@outlook.com

You may also contact the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner at: www.edoeb.admin.ch

10. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy if the website, its services or applicable legal requirements change.

The latest version will always be available on this page together with its revision date.
